[[File:Anthony Vittone at The Fellowship of the Ring premiere 2001.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Vittone at the London premiere of ''The Fellowship of the Ring'' (2001). Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Anthony Vittone''' is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref> He was senior vice president of Decipher's Fan Club Studio, which published ''Star Trek Communicator'' and the official ''Lord of the Rings'' fan club magazine.<ref name="stc138mast">''Star Trek Communicator'' 138 (2002), Decipher, masthead: "Senior VP, Fan Club Studio: Anthony F. Vittone". Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-trek-communicator-issue-138/page/n9/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="lotrfc02">Tomi M. Inkinen, "Journey of a Lifetime: The World Premiere of ''The Lord of the Rings''", ''The Lord of the Rings Fan Club Official Movie Magazine'' 2 (April/May 2002), Decipher, pp. 11–12. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/lotr-fan-club-official-movie-magazine-issue-02-gandalf-300-dpi/page/n10/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref> When the fan club sent two sweepstakes winners to the London world premiere of ''The Fellowship of the Ring'' in 2001, Vittone, his wife Elizabeth and Decipher CEO [[Warren Holland]] hosted them, and the magazine pictured them together at the premiere.<ref name="lotrfc02" /> He joined Decipher in 1999 as general counsel and vice president for business development, negotiating with Lucasfilm and Paramount Pictures, and left in 2004 for Swimways Corp.<ref name="rlm2025">[https://lawmagazine.richmond.edu/article/-/26058/nonlinear-flight-path.html Nonlinear flight path], Matthew Dewald, Richmond Law Magazine, 17 April 2025. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027200030/https://lawmagazine.richmond.edu/article/-/26058/nonlinear-flight-path.html Internet Archive]</ref>
